prompt.objetivo: When the requested phases close, leave recommendations that are useful for the real product. This is not a generic improvement list.

cuando.regla: It runs when the user closes the cycle or when continuo mode finishes the requested implementation.
It also runs when the user asks only for recommendations about the current state.

secciones.seccion: Software: product behavior that is missing, excessive, or inconsistent with the current SRS.
Technical: architecture, data, security, tests, and operation, tied to an artifact or a file.
Documentary: current documents that are missing, outdated, or contradictory.
Business: consequences of the identified model. Do not invent a market or a price.
Future capabilities: only those the SRS, the backlog, or the user deliberately left out, with the reason and the dependency.

hacer.paso: Read current artifacts and, when there is code, the code. Each recommendation cites its source.
Give it priority, cost, and risk in one line. Priority uses MoSCoW only as a label, with the reason.
Separate what blocks a release from what can wait.
If a phase was not done, say so. Do not recommend as if the system were complete.
